title: Length bound for one update
statement: For every bit string $D$, let $T(D)$ be the next state produced by the update rule that tests whether the current word is done or valid and, if it is valid, advances the index and appends the computed value. Then $|T(D)|\le |D|+10(|\pi_1(D)|+1)$, where $\pi_1$ is the total first projection of the pair encoding.
caveat: The update rule involves several nested encoded fields and operations; the prose summarizes its role rather than spelling out every branch.
